[b]Statement on Affairs in Western Shamat[/b]
We are deeply disturbed by recent developments in Western Shamat. We firmly believe that the Islamic Republic of Dabiristan has massively overstepped boundaries by jumping to such drastic and punitive measures against the state of Mizrahel without even once trying civil diplomacy to address the pertinent issue of Arab struggles in the area.

We implore that any further action taken should be one that prioritises the safeguarding of peace and stability in Western Shamat. Punitive tactics are not and should not be the way to address the ongoing Arab crisis in Mizrahel.

[quote=qartena_hadasht;60989364][spoiler= The Treaty of Tel Karmiw
[sub]A Land Transfer RP[/sub]]

The Republic of Qartena Hadasht has entered into negotiations with the Republic of Tallisland over the island of Tel Karmiw, the negotiations are centered over the Qartenian acquisition of the island. Many topics have been discussed by the two administrations, chief among them is the issue of religious freedom for the residents of the island. The Republic of Qartena Hadasht is a multi-religious state with worshipers of; Punika, Christianity, Islam, and now with the annexation of the island, Lusandrism. The Republic of Qartena Hadasht has guaranteed that the residents of the islands will be able to continue their practice of Lusandrism, uninterrupted and unimpeded by the Qartenian Government. It will also become a recognized religion in the nation. Places of worship will be exempt from taxes and holidays will be reviewed for incorporation into the Qartenian Calendar. 

Along with the assurance of religious freedom, all residents on the island will be given Qartenian Citizenship, or will be given $5,000 by the Government to assist with their relocation to another nation. This is a part of the "Peaceful Emigration Act" where individuals who live in the new "frontier territories" of the nation were offered assistance to relocate to outside of the Qartenian borders, if they so choose. The Government announced that these offers would be extended to any interested parties who currently reside on the island of Tel Karmiw. 

The Republic of Qartena Hadasht will also respect locally elected authorities, provided that they pass a Qartenian Federal Level inspection. Local elected leaders will be able to keep their post, or will be assigned to a post of equal rank for the remainder of their term. Local First Responders will also retain their employment so long as they pass a mandatory skills test that will be administered by the Adirim of Emergency Management's Standards and Training Division. Those who pass will be given a fast track to acquire First Responder Certifications in Qartena, while those who fail will have to attend the Qartenian Service Academy for their discipline of First Response. 

The Republic of Qartena Hadasht assures the Republic of Tallisland that these individuals will be well looked after and taken care of by the Government of Qartena Hadasht. The Government also advises the Republic of Tallisland to reach out with any further issues they wish to discuss in reference to this matter. 

[/spoiler]

[nation]Lusandrism[/nation][/quote]

[b]Mateusz 5:39[/b]
When Patriarch Błoński had announced to the Archbishopric of Tel Karmiw that their total rule over the island would come to an end, the leaders were outraged. Most anticipated this, those in positions of absolute power rarely wish to concede that power. 

Archbishop Ertek Ozgen in particular campaigned heavily for those beneath him to refuse to concede to Qartena Hadasht, inciting the stationed Tallislandic National Guard units leftover from the Civil War to occupy their posts and fight against the Pan-Shamatist protests sweeping across the island. 

In the meantime, Archbishop Ozgen would announce his Manifesto for Tel Karmiwan Independence, a book he had already been working on periodically for the past decade and was now preparing to publish as Qartena Hadashtian and Lusandric 'oppression' threatened to take power from him.

Only a handful of national guardsmen ever even attempted to seize their posts, the small rebellions quickly suppressed and the perpetrators arrested. Within a week of him refusing to surrender power, the Tallislandic National Guard, Police Force of Tel Karmiw, and the Lusandric Krzyżowcy [i](Crusaders)[/i] had collaborated on an operation to locate and arrest all rebellious elements of the Church on the island. Within a week, power on the island had been transferred directly to the Patriarch, and the three had announced the imprisonment of all Tel Karmiwan religious figures that had been captured.

The Manifesto of Ertek Ozgen had partially leaked online, revealing roughly the first 1/3 of his lengthy 900 page manifesto. It was incomprehensible, pushing for blatantly hypocritical religious views at times and declaring the Lusandric religion he followed false. It's effects were ultimately neglible in stifling the Pan-Shamatist demonstrations and created little to no extra Nationalist sentiment.

Ozgen, his closest supporters, and the Manifesto were all transported back to the Lusandric Church in Elseyr, to be punished before the grander council of Archbishops. In the meantime, elections for a new Archbishop for Tel Karmiw began within Tel Karmiwan churches, to be completed within a year.

With power now solely in Patriarch Błoński, he followed through with the negotiations, allowing Hadashtian officials total power over Tel Karmiw until they had established democratic elections. The Krzyżowcy returned home, taking back any in the National Guard who lived in Tallisland or did not wish to live in Tel Karmiw anymore.

[i][b]Official Statement of the Government of the Most Serene Republic of Qartena Hadasht[/b][/i]

The Government of the Most Serene Republic of Qartena Hadasht unequivocally condemns the recent aggressive actions undertaken by the Government of Rosenmarkkle. Such actions are reckless in nature and serve only to further deteriorate the already strained relations between the two organizations. For an extended period, tensions between the EDU and the THEP have remained dangerously elevated, with both sides engaged in persistent confrontation. However, recent developments have made it abundantly clear that THEP has demonstrated a lack of genuine interest in de-escalation or constructive dialogue. It cares only that they're protected from the "wolves" they would have the world believe that we are. 

It is the considered position of the Government of Qartena Hadasht that THEP has assumed the role of the primary aggressor in this situation, undermining global stability and increasing the risk of wider conflict among the nations involved. Qartena Hadasht reiterates its commitment to diplomacy, restraint, and the peaceful resolution of disputes, and urges all parties to exercise caution and pursue meaningful dialogue to prevent further escalation. THEP needs to come to the meeting table with the EDU and make a deal, so that the citizens of all nations can sleep peacefully at night.

[b]Official Statement from the Government of the Paramount State of Luscária[/b]
[i]Issued: September 11th, 2027[/i]

The Government of the Paramount State of Luscária condemns the recent acts of aggression by the Federal Commonwealth of Bob and the People's Republic of Rosenmarkke, and by extension the inaction of THEP in regards to these developments.

While the Federal Commonwealth of Bob asserts that its actions are intended to preserve order within its territory, its true intentions are made evident by the following clause: "If these rules are broken it [u][b]WILL[/b][/u] be considered a declaration of war from the nation that breaks it." This clause along with the recent actions of the People's Republic of Rosenmarkke demonstrates that these measures are not designed to maintain the continued peace of the region, it isn't to bring order to the area, it isn't even to truly enforce the laws of Bob. Rather, they serve as a thinly veiled pretext to provoke conflict with members of the EDU.

On this basis, the Paramount State of Luscária unequivocally condemns both the Federal Commonwealth of Bob and the Peoples Republic of Rosenmarkke for their destabilizing and provocative actions. Should THEP genuinely seek to ease tensions and pursue de-escalation with the EDU, it must publicly denounce the warmongering behavior of its member states. Only through such condemnation can THEP credibly demonstrate a commitment to peace between both alliances, thereby opening the path toward a future EDU-THEP conference.

At present, THEP has failed to issue any response addressing the aggression of its members toward EDU states. In light of this continued silence, the Government of the Paramount State of Luscária will take immediate and necessary measures to fulfill its obligations to its allies. Accordingly, Luscária will deploy the following forces to Lockheed to assist in maintaining regional security:
 2 light aircraft carriers
 8 submarines
 8 destroyers
 12 frigates
 12 corvettes
 52 J-35 aircraft

These actions are defensive in nature and are undertaken in the interest of preserving regional stability, deterring further aggression, and safeguarding our allies.
